{{Quote|The Mandos are being riled up by a warlord. Mean brute. Got more scars than I got horns on my head.|[[Barret]]|<ref name="TOR:PeS" />}}
This '''Individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian shock trooper|warrior]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. While on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], this man lead group of Mandalorians to plan an attack on [[Outpost Thorazan]], but the Security Chief, [[Barret]], was able gain help from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] spacers to assist in defending the outpost. The spacers attacked the leader's base, killing him and his warriors with him.<ref name="TOR:PeS" />
